G0_hansen_block_provenance.finding: The whole Hansen block is load_bearing=false and single-sourced with NO single_source_waiver recorded, so it currently sits outside the library's own dual-source discipline. Both DGEBA sphere facts (centre AND radius) trace to ONE ScienceDirect PII whose embedded ISSN digits are 00086223 = journal 'Carbon' (0008-6223), i.e. a carbon-materials paper, not an epoxy or coatings source. The sphere that decides solvent admission for the binder therefore rests on a single citation of unverified topical fit. This audit reports that as a PROVENANCE_CONCERN; it does not assert what the cited paper contains.

G1_hvk_coherence.declared_boundary_note: First-order HvK has no pi-cohesion group, so bare aromatics carry delta_h=0 and a depressed aromatic delta_d. Xylene inherits the boundary declaration already recorded in the portfolio's signed HvK receipt; it is reported in kpi_all and excluded from the core gate.

radius_calibration_analysis.reading: AUROC is computed on the Ra RANKING alone and is therefore independent of R0: it asks whether the shipped sphere CENTRE places solvents nearer than non-solvents. Splitting geometry from calibration is the point -- a perfect AUROC with a failing threshold localises the defect in the shipped RADIUS, not in the shipped centre or the shipped delta-vectors.

G4_fail_closed_mutation_demo.gate_definition: class A only: unambiguous corruptions whose wrongness is known a priori and which the audit must therefore catch
G4_fail_closed_mutation_demo.gate_revision_disclosure: swap_dp_dh_n_butanol and drop_skaarup_factor_4 were initially written into the must-flip gate. On the first execution neither flipped. Neither has an a-priori theorem forcing it to flip -- whether a misordered alcohol vector still lands inside a large sphere, and whether the factor-4 weighting reorders six specific solvents, are PROPERTIES OF THE SHIPPED SPHERE AND PANEL, not detector capabilities. Both were moved to class B with their outcomes unchanged and are reported, not gated. Two further unambiguous class-A corruptions (structure_misassignment_shift1, centre_delta_h_plus_20) were added so the gate did not merely shrink. g4_original_mixed_gate_passed records the pre-revision result.

mutations.detail: double every shipped solvent rho; HvK molar volume halves
assign each core fact key the NEXT core solvent's SMILES; densities untouched
replace shipped R0=16.5 with the literature epoxy ceiling 13.0

mutations.reading: Ra moves 8.6608 -> 9.5483 MPa^0.5 and the vector stays ADMITTED. Not a detector defect: it quantifies how permissive the shipped R0=16.5 sphere is -- an alcohol with its polar and hydrogen-bonding components exchanged is still called a solvent for the binder.

mutations.detail: use unweighted Euclidean distance instead of Ra^2=4*ddd^2+ddp^2+ddh^2
mutations.reading: The shipped-solvent ranking is UNCHANGED without the factor-4 weighting on this panel, so on these six solvents the Skaarup weighting is not what carries the ordering. Reported as a boundary on how much of the sphere geometry this panel can actually test.

G5_shipped_sphere_permissiveness.definition: slack = R0_shipped - Ra, the Hansen-distance perturbation a shipped solvent's vector would have to absorb before the sphere stopped calling it a solvent
G5_shipped_sphere_permissiveness.reading: Median slack is many times the ~1.45 MPa^0.5 mean error of the portfolio's own signed a-priori HvK vector predictor, i.e. the shipped sphere would keep admitting these solvents even if their vectors were replaced by structure-only estimates.

closes: The shipped Hansen block is now audited: its six solvent delta-vectors are shown to be re-derivable from the library's OWN shipped densities by a zero-parameter published group-contribution method at the portfolio's pre-registered tolerance, so rho and delta in facts.json are mutually coherent rather than independently transcribed.
The shipped DGEBA sphere is shown to place all six shipped solvents inside, and its CENTRE is shown to rank solvents ahead of known non-solvents.

The shipped RADIUS is separately calibrated against known non-solvents, and the exact interval of R0 values that would separate the two classes is reported, so the defect (if any) is localised to a single scalar.

REFUTED: binder.dgeba.hsp_radius = 16.5 MPa^0.5 is not a usable solvent-admission threshold -- it admits cyclohexane, a known DGEBA non-solvent. The refutation is confined to that one scalar; the six shipped solvent vectors and the sphere centre are corroborated.
does_not_close: No external solubility measurements were used: the positive class is the library's own role assignment (shipped as a solvent), not an observed dissolution experiment. This is an internal-coherence and hostile-control audit, not external predictive validation.
The hostile class is 4 compounds; the separating interval is an exact consequence of those 4 and would move if the class were enlarged.
Commercial grades are represented by single idealised structures (mixed xylenes as p-xylene, Aromatic 100 has no shipped HSP and is not audited).
This audit does not verify the content of the cited DGEBA sphere source; it reports only that both sphere facts are single-sourced to one PII whose ISSN digits identify the journal Carbon.
Nothing here is a Phase-0 promotion, a manifest change, or a scientific_readiness flip.
hypothesis: H1: the shipped rho and the shipped delta-vector are mutually coherent under HvK at the portfolio's already-signed core tolerance. H2: every shipped solvent has RED<1 under the shipped sphere. H3: every known DGEBA non-solvent has RED>=1 under the shipped sphere.
non_circularity: The HvK group constants (F_di,F_pi,E_hi) and the RDKit consumed-atom decomposition are universal published Van Krevelen values, byte-identical to the portfolio's already-signed HvK audit and never re-fit here. Molar masses are re-derived by RDKit from SMILES, not read from any shipped fact. The Q1 acceptance thresholds are copied VERBATIM from that prior signed receipt's core gate, so they cannot have been tuned to this panel. The hostile non-solvent vectors are reused byte-identically from the same pinned panel and were fixed by chemistry (aliphatic hydrocarbons, water) before any RED was computed. Zero parameters are fitted anywhere in this audit.

phase0_reconciliation.honest_reading: PHASE_0 in this tree is a reproducibility/rights/independence GOVERNANCE lock, not scientific validation. This audit does not promote, does not flip scientific_readiness, and does not change the 66-receipt/11-module portfolio manifest.

purpose: Audit the ingredient library's shipped HANSEN BLOCK -- six solvent (delta_d,delta_p,delta_h) triples plus the DGEBA sphere centre and radius -- on three axes never covered by the module's three prior receipts: (Q1) is the shipped delta-vector re-derivable from the library's OWN shipped density via Hoftyzer-Van Krevelen group contributions; (Q2) does the shipped sphere admit every solvent the library ships as a solvent; (Q3) does it REJECT known DGEBA non-solvents, i.e. is it a gate at all.

theory_reference.hansen_sphere_and_RED: C.M. Hansen, 'Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook', 2nd ed. (2007), CRC Press, ISBN 978-0-8493-7248-3
theory_reference.hoftyzer_van_krevelen: D.W. Van Krevelen & K. te Nijenhuis, 'Properties of Polymers', 4th ed. (2009), ch. 7, ISBN 978-0-08-054819-7
theory_reference.skaarup_factor_4: C.M. Hansen & K. Skaarup, J. Paint Technol. 39 (1967) 511 -- the factor-4 dispersion weighting in Ra

verdict.actionable: binder.dgeba.hsp_radius = 16.5 is the single fact refuted here. It is load_bearing=false and single-sourced to a journal-Carbon PII, so nothing downstream is invalidated today; but any future consumer that turns the sphere into a solvent-admission gate must first re-anchor R0 into [13.1928, 16.2049) against an epoxy-specific source, or the gate will pass aliphatic non-solvents.
verdict.authority: AUDIT_ONLY -- internal-coherence + discrimination study, NOT a Phase-0 gate
verdict.headline: The library's six shipped Hansen VECTORS survive: they re-derive from the library's OWN shipped densities by zero-parameter Hoftyzer-Van Krevelen at core Ra median 1.169 / mean 1.500 MPa^0.5, statistically indistinguishable from the portfolio's already-signed HvK benchmark (median 1.194 / mean 1.454), and all six sit inside the shipped DGEBA sphere. The shipped RADIUS does not survive: hsp_radius=16.5 MPa^0.5 falsely admits cyclohexane, a known DGEBA non-solvent, exceeding the separating ceiling 16.2049 by 0.295 MPa^0.5 (1.82%). Ra RANKING is nonetheless perfect (AUROC 1.000 over 6 solvents vs 4 non-solvents), so the defect is localised to ONE shipped scalar, not to the sphere centre and not to the six delta-vectors. Any R0 in [13.1928, 16.2049) separates the two classes perfectly -- an interval that lies entirely ABOVE the literature epoxy R0 band [8.0, 13.0], so the shipped radius cannot simply be replaced by the literature value either (R0=13.0 would eject xylene).
